name: im2 - CSEM inversion benchmark, synthetic model 2
description: Controlled 3-D CSEM inversion: a checkerboard of four 200 m cubes - two 10 ohm-m conductors and two 1000 ohm-m resistors - in a 100 ohm-m halfspace, recovered from noisy multi-frequency surface data.
_coordinates: z NEGATIVE down (depth is a negative z), matching examples/fm; z = 0 is the air/earth interface.
_run: 112 MPI tasks, PCBDDC (configs/solver_bddc.txt), 00:57:28. Mesh 57276 cells, 355502 DOFs at order 2. The domain decomposition is part of the configuration: reproduce at 112 tasks.

true_model._search_boxes: One quadrant of the INVERT footprint per body, so a smeared reconstruction is still attributed to the right target and no cell is counted twice.

convergence._iterations_not_reproducible: The step count is NOT reproducible to the unit. Two runs from the same bundle on 112 tasks agree to four decimals through iteration 20 and drift to ~1 % in RMS by iteration 70: round-off non-determinism in the MPI reductions of the iterative solver, amplified by L-BFGS. Expect 100-115 steps, not exactly 105.

recovered_model._cross_contamination: Wrong-sign cells among the 6330 inside the four true boxes. Outside them, 75 conductive and 1 resistive cell are anomalous, all 104-148 m from their own body centre (a cube corner is at 173 m), i.e. the smearing halo rather than artifacts.
recovered_model._amplitude: mean_ohm_m is the volume-weighted geometric mean inside box_m and is what describes the body; peak_ohm_m is a single-cell extremum and overshoots past the truth for the conductors. log_contrast_recovered is the fraction of |log10(rho_true/rho_background)| that the mean represents: the conductors recover about 2.3x more of their contrast than the resistors, which is the expected asymmetry - a CSEM field is far more sensitive to a conductor than to a resistor of equal contrast.

tolerances._basis: Bands around the measured run, wide enough for the run-to-run drift above and for a re-meshed discretisation; tight enough to fail if a body is lost, misplaced or comes back with the wrong sign.
tolerances._resistor_offsets: R1 and R2 fall back to the global 100 m bound: at the 300 ohm-m threshold they are 62 and 86 cells, so their centroid is correspondingly noisy (73.7 m against 7.8 m for the same true geometry).
